detail.body:
## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the applicable `AGENTS.md` Hard Rules and my changes comply.
- [x] I added the required category, area, and origin labels.

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels / FROST compiled-artifact cache.

## Summary

When multiple processes start with the same empty FROST cache, each currently compiles the same kernel before publishing its artifact. Add a POSIX advisory lock per environment/artifact key, and recheck the cache after acquiring it so waiting processes load the first published artifact.

Warm cache hits remain lock-free, and different keys can compile concurrently. The OS releases locks on process exit, including compiler failure or termination. If locking is unavailable, compilation retains the existing best-effort behavior. Lock files stay outside the prunable environment directories and are not unlinked while callers may hold them.

## Why

Atomic publication prevents partial artifacts but does not prevent duplicated compilation during multi-process cold starts. This addresses that shared-cache race without changing kernel selection or generated code.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

No public API or cache-record changes. Cross-process deduplication requires a filesystem supporting POSIX advisory locks; other environments continue compiling without deduplication. Existing uncached execution and best-effort export fallbacks remain functional. A miss that cannot export a reusable artifact still requires each caller to compile; same-key misses are serialized while locking is available.

## Testing

- Host regressions with real subprocesses and filesystem locks, using a fake compiler: four simultaneous cold callers compile once; a warm caller avoids locking; different keys compile concurrently; compiler exceptions and process termination release the lock; unavailable locking falls back safely.
- Observed the four-caller test fail on the base implementation (four compilations), then pass with this patch.
- `PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q --confcutdir=test/python/core/frost -o addopts='' test/python/core/frost/test_compiled_cache.py test/python/core/frost/test_compiled_cache_concurrency.py`: **26 passed**.
- Scoped `pre-commit run --files ...`: all applicable checks passed.
- On B200, `python -m pytest -q -o addopts='' -m L0 core/frost/test_compiled_cache.py core/frost/test_compiled_cache_concurrency.py gemm/frost/test_compiled_cache_gpu.py`: **28 passed**, including real GPU subprocesses sharing one compilation, numerical agreement with a PyTorch reference, and identical output digests.
- GPU environment: cuDNN Frontend built from this branch at `8144911ac87948d2f507c94fca4d4d8c640bc14a`, cuDNN 9.27.0.42, CuTe DSL 4.8.0, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, driver 615.71.09.
- A four-rank B200 comparison passed all 24 rank/phase checks (base and candidate; cold, artifact-warm, saved-winner warm), including eager and graph-replay numerical checks. Each rank used a separate GPU and eight pinned CPU cores. The route was FlashInfer `mm_bf16(backend="cudnn")` with FROST engines enabled, `M={8,64,256}`, `N=1024`, `K=2048`; traces recorded `cudnn.gemm.frost.engine.FrostGemmEngine`. FlashInfer was fixed at `89b3a6c40eae749e20ff36c3e388f98a33a9ef3e`; FE base was `e4529fe5f573e230ded3104cd9d472775c4ca9ce`.

| Cache state | Base total compilations / four ranks | Patched total compilations / four ranks | Base tuning wall time / rank | Patched tuning wall time / rank |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 64 | 16 | 31.73–31.77 s | 27.72–27.75 s |
| Artifacts only | 0 | 0 | 3.83–3.95 s | 6.08–6.36 s |
| Artifacts + saved winners | 0 | 0 | 3.24–3.25 s | 3.23–3.26 s |

These are one paired startup measurement, not serving throughput or a claim of uniform latency improvement. The slower artifacts-only sample came predominantly from `create_execution_plans`, before the compiled-cache path (rank 0: 0.61 s base / 3.05 s patched); compiled-cache time itself was 1.55 s / 1.43 s. All artifacts-only and saved-winner processes had zero compiler calls and zero export failures. The deterministic improvement is removing 48 duplicate cold compilations; plan enumeration and profiling remain separate startup costs.

Review follow-up: commit `5fc94bdc638ff1c33e8ec1b93e0dcfb0a1a500b9` adds contract docstrings in response to the review coverage warning; runtime behavior is unchanged. The 26 host regressions were rerun successfully.

Internal CI on `5fc94bd` (pipeline 74799147): the SM100 FROST GEMM lane passed **6,420 tests** (3,597 skipped), including both real-GPU disk-cache tests. The core/FROST lane passed all **26 cache tests**; its sole failure is the existing SDPA kernel-name-prefix guard, reproduced unchanged on base `e4529fe`. The full-repository guardword scan also flags an unchanged norm README line already present in that base. These two baseline failures keep the internal pipeline red; they are not reported as a clean pipeline.

Combined integration validation: an unpushed merge preview of #1707 `5fc94bd` and #1708 `f78a808` (merge commit `4da9afe`) passed **33 tests** on SM103 with CuTe DSL 4.8.0: 22 cache tests, 5 concurrency tests, 4 linear-attention fresh-process tests, and 2 GEMM GPU cache tests. All four linear-attention families reported zero warm-process compiler calls.

@@ -926,6 +926,16 @@ artifact can never be reused by accident:
   yields a loadable entry without its key.
 - **Anything doubtful is a miss**: missing, malformed, mismatched, or an
   object `load_module` refuses (an arch the device cannot run). Never an error.
+- **Concurrent cold callers share a compilation on POSIX.** A cache miss takes
+  an advisory lock for its environment and artifact key, then checks the cache
+  again before compiling. Different keys can compile concurrently; cache hits
+  do not acquire the lock. The OS releases it when a compiler exits, including
+  after a crash. If locking is unavailable, compilation and best-effort export
+  continue without deduplication. Empty lock files live in `<root>/.locks/`,
+  outside the prunable environments, and are retained to keep one stable lock
+  inode per key while other processes may be waiting. Do not unlink them while
+  the cache is in use. Filesystems must support POSIX advisory locking to
+  deduplicate callers sharing that cache.
 - **A hit and a miss run the same thing.** A reloaded tvm-ffi function is
   positional-only, so it is wrapped with the kwargs wrapper the DSL itself
   uses, rebuilt from the RUNTIME spec the record carries (`arg_names`,

+@contextmanager
+def _entry_lock(root: Path, entry: Path):
+    """Best-effort process lock, released by the OS if the compiler dies.
+
+    Lock files live outside the prunable environment directories and are never
+    unlinked: replacing an inode while a waiter holds it would create two locks
+    for the same artifact. They contain no kernel data.
+    """
+    lock_file = None
+    try:
+        import fcntl
+
+        lock_dir = root / ".locks"
+        lock_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        lock_file = (lock_dir / f"{entry.parent.name}-{entry.name}.lock").open("a+b")
+        fcntl.flock(lock_file.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+    except (ImportError, OSError) as exc:
+        if lock_file is not None:
+            lock_file.close()
+            lock_file = None
+        # Persistence has always been optional; an unavailable lock must not
+        # prevent an otherwise valid compilation, or hide a compiler failure.
+        _LOG.warning("compiled-plan cache: cannot lock %s (%s); compiling without a process lock", entry, exc)
+    except BaseException:
+        if lock_file is not None:
+            lock_file.close()
+        raise
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        if lock_file is not None:
+            lock_file.close()
+
+
+def _compile_and_export(fn, args, kwargs, root, entry, cache_key, symbol, manifest):
+    """Compile a miss and return its reloaded artifact when export is supported."""
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+
     compiled = cute.compile(fn, *args, **kwargs)

     execution_args = getattr(compiled, "execution_args", None)

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Process-level cache contracts, with a fake compiler and real filesystem locks."""
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+import pytest
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.L0, pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "posix", reason="POSIX artifact locks")]
+_SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "python/cudnn/frost/compiled_cache.py"
+
+_CHILD = r"""
+import importlib.util, json, os, sys, time, types
+from pathlib import Path
+source, directory, rank, key, mode = sys.argv[1:]
+root = Path(directory)
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cache_under_test', source)
+cc = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(cc)
+cc.set_cache_dir(root / 'cache')
+cc.environment_manifest = lambda: {'schema': cc._SCHEMA, 'cudnn_frontend': 'test'}
+cc._memo_device = lambda: (0, 0)
+cc._wrapper_spec_of = lambda *a: {'arg_names': [], 'arg_defaults': [], 'kwonly_names': [], 'kwonly_defaults': {}}
+cc._prune_once = lambda *a: None
+os.environ.pop(cc._ENV_DISABLE, None)
+os.environ[cc._ENV_MEMO] = '0'
+
+def wait(path):
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+    while not path.exists():
+        if time.monotonic() > deadline:
+            raise TimeoutError(str(path))
+        time.sleep(.01)
+
+first = True
+def load(entry, expected_key, symbol):
+    global first
+    if first:
+        first = False
+        (root / ('ready-' + rank)).touch()
+        wait(root / 'start')
+    record = cc._read_json(entry / cc._ENTRY)
+    if record and record['key'] == expected_key and (entry / cc._OBJECT).read_text() == expected_key:
+        return 'reloaded'
+    return None
+cc._try_load = load
+
+class Compiled:
+    def export_to_c(self, path, function_name):
+        Path(path).write_text(key)
+
+def compile(*args, **kwargs):
+    (root / ('compiled-' + rank)).touch()
+    if mode == 'fail':
+        raise RuntimeError('injected compiler failure')
+    if mode == 'hold':
+        wait(root / 'finish')
+    # Give every simultaneous cold caller a chance to observe the miss.
+    time.sleep(.1)
+    return Compiled()
+
+cute = types.ModuleType('cutlass.cute')
+cute.compile = compile
+cutlass = types.ModuleType('cutlass')
+cutlass.cute = cute
+sys.modules.update({'cutlass': cutlass, 'cutlass.cute': cute})
+if mode == 'unavailable':
+    (root / 'cache').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (root / 'cache' / '.locks').write_text('not a directory')
+if mode == 'warm':
+    def no_lock(*args):
+        raise AssertionError('a cache hit acquired a compiler lock')
+    cc._entry_lock = no_lock
+result = cc.compile_cached(lambda: None, cache_key=key, options='--enable-tvm-ffi')
+(root / ('result-' + rank)).write_text(json.dumps({'result': result, 'stats': cc.stats()}))
+"""
+
+
+def _start(root, rank, key="shared", mode="normal"):
+    """Start an independent cache caller with a retained per-process log."""
+    log = (root / f"log-{rank}").open("w")
+    process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", _CHILD, str(_SOURCE), str(root), str(rank), key, mode], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+    log.close()
+    return process
+
+
+def _wait_files(root, prefix, count, processes):
+    """Wait for the child-process barrier while detecting early exits."""
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
+    while len(list(root.glob(prefix + "*"))) < count:
+        assert all(p.poll() is None for p in processes), [p.returncode for p in processes]
+        assert time.monotonic() < deadline, f"timed out waiting for {prefix}"
+        time.sleep(0.01)
+
+
+def _finish(root, processes, expected=0):
+    """Join callers and surface the failing child's diagnostic log."""
+    for rank, process in processes:
+        assert process.wait(timeout=30) == expected, (root / f"log-{rank}").read_text()
+
+
+def _cleanup(processes):
+    """Reap all children, including those left running after an assertion."""
+    for process in processes:
+        if process.poll() is None:
+            process.kill()
+        process.wait(timeout=5)
+
+
+def test_frost_cold_processes_compile_one_artifact(tmp_path):
+    """Cold callers share one compilation and a fresh warm caller takes no lock."""
+    processes = [_start(tmp_path, rank) for rank in range(4)]
+    try:
+        _wait_files(tmp_path, "ready-", 4, processes)
+        (tmp_path / "start").touch()
+        _finish(tmp_path, list(enumerate(processes)))
+        assert len(list(tmp_path.glob("compiled-*"))) == 1
+        results = [json.loads((tmp_path / f"result-{rank}").read_text()) for rank in range(4)]
+        assert all(r["result"] == "reloaded" for r in results)
+        assert sum(r["stats"]["misses"] for r in results) == 1
+        assert sum(r["stats"]["hits"] for r in results) == 3
+        warm = _start(tmp_path, "warm", mode="warm")
+        processes.append(warm)
+        _finish(tmp_path, [("warm", warm)])
+        assert not (tmp_path / "compiled-warm").exists()
+    finally:
+        _cleanup(processes)
+
+
+def test_frost_different_keys_can_compile_concurrently(tmp_path):
+    """Unrelated artifacts must enter their compilers without waiting for each other."""
+    processes = [_start(tmp_path, rank, key=str(rank), mode="hold") for rank in range(2)]
+    try:
+        _wait_files(tmp_path, "ready-", 2, processes)
+        (tmp_path / "start").touch()
+        _wait_files(tmp_path, "compiled-", 2, processes)
+        (tmp_path / "finish").touch()
+        _finish(tmp_path, list(enumerate(processes)))
+    finally:
+        _cleanup(processes)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["fail", "kill"])
+def test_frost_compiler_failure_releases_the_artifact_lock(tmp_path, failure):
+    """Compiler exceptions and process termination must not strand the next caller."""
+    owner = _start(tmp_path, "owner", mode="hold" if failure == "kill" else "fail")
+    processes = [owner]
+    try:
+        _wait_files(tmp_path, "ready-", 1, processes)
+        (tmp_path / "start").touch()
+        if failure == "kill":
+            _wait_files(tmp_path, "compiled-", 1, processes)
+            owner.kill()
+            owner.wait(timeout=5)
+        else:
+            _finish(tmp_path, [("owner", owner)], expected=1)
+            assert "injected compiler failure" in (tmp_path / "log-owner").read_text()
+        retry = _start(tmp_path, "retry")
+        processes.append(retry)
+        _finish(tmp_path, [("retry", retry)])
+        assert (tmp_path / "compiled-retry").exists()
+        assert json.loads((tmp_path / "result-retry").read_text())["result"] == "reloaded"
+    finally:
+        _cleanup(processes)
+
+
+def test_frost_unavailable_lock_keeps_compilation_functional(tmp_path):
+    """An unusable lock directory preserves best-effort compilation and export."""
+    process = _start(tmp_path, "fallback", mode="unavailable")
+    try:
+        _wait_files(tmp_path, "ready-", 1, [process])
+        (tmp_path / "start").touch()
+        _finish(tmp_path, [("fallback", process)])
+        assert json.loads((tmp_path / "result-fallback").read_text())["result"] == "reloaded"
+        assert "compiling without a process lock" in (tmp_path / "log-fallback").read_text()
+    finally:
+        _cleanup([process])

 A, B = g.tensor_like(a), g.tensor_like(b)
@@ -36,6 +46,7 @@

+torch.testing.assert_close(c.float(), a.float() @ b.float(), rtol=.02, atol=.1)
 launch = g._compiled_plans[idx]._compiled._launchable

     second = _run(tmp_path)
     assert second["stats"]["misses"] == 0 and second["stats"]["hits"] >= 1, second
     assert second["digest"] == first["digest"], "the reloaded kernel must compute exactly what the compiled one did"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "posix", reason="POSIX artifact locks")

+    """Concurrent GPU callers share one artifact and produce identical GEMM outputs."""
+    env = dict(

+    )

+    processes = []
+    try:
+        for rank in range(2):
+            processes.append(

+                    [sys.executable, "-c", _CHILD, str(tmp_path / f"rank{rank}.json")], env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True
+                )
+            )
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 120
+        while len(list(tmp_path.glob("*.ready"))) < 2:
+            assert all(p.poll() is None for p in processes), "a cache-test child exited before the barrier"
+            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "cache-test children did not reach the barrier"
+            time.sleep(0.01)
+        (tmp_path / "release").touch()
+        for process in processes:
+            output, _ = process.communicate(timeout=600)
+            assert process.returncode == 0, output[-4000:]
+        results = [json.loads((tmp_path / f"rank{rank}.json").read_text()) for rank in range(2)]
+        assert sum(r["stats"]["misses"] for r in results) == 1, results
+        assert sum(r["stats"]["hits"] for r in results) == 1, results
+        assert all(r["reloaded"] for r in results)

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `5fc94bdc638f` against base `ae7493d2bae4`.

Completed review; no actionable defect found. The lock is scoped to the existing environment/artifact identity and held through publication/reload. The second lookup closes the cold-start race, while warm hits and unsupported-cache bypasses remain outside the lock. Keeping lock inodes outside pruned environment directories preserves waiter coordination.

Validation: 26 cache tests passed, including real-process checks for one compilation across four cold callers, lock-free warm hits, parallel different keys, exception/termination recovery and unavailable-lock fallback. The new four-caller test failed on the unchanged base with four compilations and passed on this head with one. Two native SM100 GPU cache tests passed with DSL 4.7.0 and verified source/binding imports in the parent and all four children. For BF16 GEMM M256/N512/K256, two concurrent cold processes produced one miss and one hit, both returned reloaded artifacts, and both passed full numerical comparison with identical output digests. Sequential fresh-process warm reload also passed; no export failures occurred. Reused current-head pipeline 74799147, whose integration matches all five changed files: 21 passed, 2 failed, 6 skipped, 10 manual. GEMM SM100 and C++ sanitizer lanes passed. The author reports the core cache tests passed and attributes its kernel-prefix assertion and guardword failure to the unchanged base; those failed jobs remain failed.

Limitations: My concurrency validation used a local POSIX filesystem and one SM100 GPU. I did not independently repeat the author's four-GPU startup timing or test a shared network filesystem. Removing duplicate compilation is verified; it is not a claim of uniform startup or serving latency improvement. CI raw traces and the author's combined #1707/#1708 SM103 run are peer evidence. The newer base only adds #1709 SDPA scheduling; cache, GEMM and binding inputs are unchanged.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.
